raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical aspect ratio of the modeled half-beam",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.4 gives hexagon counts and rfill/max-length ratios, but no transverse dimension. Sec. 3.1 omits the coordinate formulas. A 3:1 element-count ratio does not uniquely specify the physical aspect ratio of a hexagonal mesh. Here L and H denote the horizontal and vertical half-domain extents.",
      "readings": [
        "L/H = 3, interpreting the count ratio as the physical aspect ratio",
        "L/H = 2√3, using nominal hexagonal lattice pitches Δx:Δy = √3:1.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Outer boundary of the half-domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 assigns the domain geometry to Fig. 1(a). The prose does not establish whether the honeycomb mesh represents a straight rectangular boundary or a stepped boundary.",
      "readings": [
        "A rectangle with straight outer boundaries",
        "The union of complete hexagons, retaining a stepped outer perimeter"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Mesh associated with Fig. 2(a)",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.4 lists three mesh sizes; the Fig. 2 caption assigns filters to rows but does not explicitly assign mesh sizes to columns. Associating 2(a) with the first listed mesh is natural but implicit.",
      "readings": [
        "60 × 20 hexagons, following the order of the mesh list",
        "120 × 40 hexagons",
        "300 × 100 hexagons"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Hexagonal lattice coordinates and connectivity",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 describes coordinate and connectivity arrays without supplying their formulas. Lattice orientation, staggering, boundary coordinates, and the precise removal of hanging nodes cannot be reconstructed from the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Point-up hexagons in staggered rows, with nominal pitches Δx:Δy = √3:1.5 and alternating half-horizontal-pitch offsets",
        "Flat-top hexagons in staggered columns, with nominal pitches Δx:Δy = 1.5:√3 and alternating half-vertical-pitch offsets"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Symmetry boundary",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 explicitly identifies a symmetric half-domain but leaves its boundary conditions to Fig. 1(a). The symmetry edge is not identified in the prose.",
      "readings": [
        "The entire left edge x = 0 is the symmetry cut",
        "The entire right edge x = L is the symmetry cut, with the remaining setup mirrored"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Physical bearing location and footprint",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Fig. 1(a) contains the supports; Sec. 3.2 merely names fixeddofs. For a convention with the symmetry cut at x = 0, neither the bearing position nor its spatial extent is stated.",
      "readings": [
        "One supported node at the lower outer corner (L, 0)",
        "One supported node at the upper outer corner (L, H)",
        "A supported lower-edge segment 0.95L ≤ x ≤ L, y = 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Displacement components restrained at the physical bearing",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 provides no entries for the MBB fixeddofs array. The physical support's restrained displacement components are therefore unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical roller: u_y = 0, with u_x free",
        "Pin: u_x = u_y = 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "MBB load application location",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 refers to external load F in Fig. 1(a). Sec. 3.2 does not give the MBB force-array indices. With the symmetry cut placed at x = 0, the application coordinates remain unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Upper symmetry corner (0, H)",
        "Midheight of the symmetry edge (0, H/2)",
        "Lower symmetry corner (0, 0)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the MBB load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 2 nor Sec. 3.2 states whether F is concentrated at one node or distributed over a boundary region. For an upper symmetry-corner load, these are distinct implementations.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the entire resultant to the single corner node",
        "Apply a uniform traction over 0 ≤ x ≤ 0.05L on the upper edge, with total resultant F",
        "Distribute the resultant equally among the boundary nodes in that same patch"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of the MBB force",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The supplied prose calls the load F without specifying its vector components; the direction is left to Fig. 1(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward: direction (0, -1)",
        "Vertical upward: direction (0, 1)",
        "Inclined downward: direction (1/√2, -1/√2), where the application permits both components"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Force magnitude and half-domain normalization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical MBB force magnitude is supplied. The force values in Sec. 4 belong to other examples. The text also does not specify whether a nominal resultant refers to the full beam or the modeled half.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit resultant applied to the modeled half-domain",
        "Unit resultant for the full beam, represented by a half-domain resultant of 0.5",
        "A half-domain resultant of 1000 in a consistent physical unit system"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio of the solid material",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 3.2 specify Young's-modulus interpolation and plane stress, but give no Poisson's ratio for constructing k0.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic material with ν = 0.3",
        "Isotropic material with ν = 0.25",
        "Isotropic material with ν = 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Absolute solid Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 fixes Emin/E0, and Sec. 3.2 says E0 is stored on line 12, but its value is absent. Defining k0 at unit modulus does not specify E0.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 1 in normalized units, with Emin = 10^-9",
        "E0 = 210 GPa, with Emin = 210 Pa"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The plane-stress assumption in Sec. 3.2 does not specify the thickness multiplying the element stiffness.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t = 1 in the chosen length unit",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length unit"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Numerical integration of the hexagonal element stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 identifies six-node Wachpress elements under plane stress but supplies neither KE nor its integration procedure. The element formulation is named; its numerical realization is incomplete.",
      "readings": [
        "Split each hexagon into six centroid-to-edge triangles and use three-point quadrature on each triangle",
        "Use the same subdivision with seven-point quadrature on each triangle",
        "Use adaptive integration of the Wachpress stiffness integrand to a prescribed accuracy"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimality-criteria update and damping",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 3.3 specify standard optimality criteria but omit the actual update expression and damping exponent.",
      "readings": [
        "Multiplicative update x_new = x[-dc/(λ dv)]^0.5, clipped to the move and density bounds",
        "The same update with exponent 0.25"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC move limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 says move is defined on line 80 but does not give its value.",
      "readings": [
        "Maximum absolute density change of 0.2 per iteration",
        "Maximum absolute density change of 0.1 per iteration",
        "No additional move restriction beyond 0 ≤ x ≤ 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC multiplier-search bracket and tolerance",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 mentions the optimization search interval inL without its bounds, bracketing procedure, or stopping tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Bisection on λ in [0, 10^9], stopping when relative interval width is at most 10^-3",
        "The same bracket with relative interval width at most 10^-6",
        "Expand the upper bracket until it encloses the volume-satisfying multiplier, then bisect to absolute interval width 10^-6"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization convergence metric and tolerance",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 says change monitors convergence, but supplies neither its formula nor the termination threshold.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when max_j |x_new,j - x_old,j| ≤ 0.01",
        "Stop when max_j |x_new,j - x_old,j| ≤ 0.001",
        "Stop when the mean absolute density change is at most 0.001"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Maximum optimization iteration count",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 names maxiter but gives no value or indication whether Fig. 2(a) terminated by convergence or by reaching that cap.",
      "readings": [
        "Maximum 200 iterations",
        "Maximum 1000 iterations",
        "Maximum 2000 iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
